theme: Croatia countdown — bookings to close before the 8th.
greeting: A light calendar today, Dan — one governance call at noon and the rest of the day yours. The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete, and the Croatia trip is now a week out with a few bookings still open.

needsAttention.title: Croatia lodging gaps still open
needsAttention.detail: Two P1 bookings remain: the Sept 19 Cavtat night after the charter disembarks, and the St. Pete landing gap Sept 20-22 before the kids' pickup. Both have to be done from dry land before you fly Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Croatia ticket shows 0 checked bags. Pull it up on Eurowings Discover's site with the record locator, confirm the allowance there, and buy online now — airport-counter fees run well above pre-purchase.

needsAttention.title: Build the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: The Kenwood stay ends and the House 1 to House 2 changeover is Sept 3. Pack the pantry tote before then so the first migration is a test run while there's still time to fix it.

needsAttention.title: Conor Kehoe wants to reconnect
needsAttention.detail: His office re-sent a Zoom invite this morning — Conor thinks your reply got lost in the holiday confusion and Kate will set a time if a PRI chat still helps. A warm intro from Eugenia Jackson worth not letting cool.

schedule.title: NACD New England call
schedule.detail: Zoom with Larissa Ravetto, Ellen Richstone, Deb Rosenthal

flagged.title: Conor Kehoe reconnect
flagged.detail: Zoom invite re-sent through his assistant; a reply keeps the PRI intro warm.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley statement ready
flagged.detail: New account statement is available to review online.

flagged.title: Nautilus charter paid
flagged.detail: QuickBooks confirms the sailing-charter payment went through.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — NYT Cooking, Kayak trip nudges, ExecThread, chocolate and bookshop mail.

recipe.title: Onion Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's cooler evenings are made for slow, savory baking with the season's abundant onions.

acts.line: A clear stretch with the girls in the house — routines and the last of the trip errands.
The NACD New England call at noon was the day's one fixed point; the rest is Croatia logistics.
Wind toward the Sept 3 house move — the larder bin is the thing to have packed.
